about.title: About Me
about.heading: Background & Interests
paragraphs: I’m Drew, a sophomore studying mechanical engineering at CU Boulder with a minor in physics. Growing up, I liked building models and LEGO. One Christmas, my dad and I built a four-foot-tall robot kit. Helping with electrical, plumbing, and carpentry projects around the house also got me interested in hands-on work.

Physics was my favorite subject during my junior and senior years of high school, so I entered college as an engineering physics major. During freshman year, I realized I especially enjoyed CAD and working through different versions of a design. I switched to mechanical engineering for broader career options and more opportunities to design and build physical systems. I kept physics as a minor because I still enjoyed it.

Scouting, especially leading my Eagle Scout project, helped me realize how much I enjoy designing and building with other people. I’m interested in automotive engineering, aerospace, clean energy, and applications of physics, but I’m still figuring out which direction I want to pursue. Outside of class, I enjoy cars, backpacking, camping, skiing, and hands-on projects.
